payment/medusa/orderItemQuantities#never.note: Refuted by fulfil 1, ship 1, cancel the fulfilment of 1 (shipped 1 > fulfilled 0); @medusajs/order@2.22.0 does the same. CANCEL_ITEM_FULFILLMENT checks only the fulfilled count; the module leaves 'not a shipped fulfilment' to core-flows cancel-order-fulfillment.ts:127 (`if (fulfillment.shipped_at)` throws). Restated as the step law 'only a cancelled fulfilment takes the shipped past the fulfilled'.

Refuted by fulfil 1, deliver 1, cancel the fulfilment of 1; the original does the same. payment/medusa/orderItemQuantities#never.note: Suspected real bug at the module's action level. With positive quantities: fulfil 1, return 1, receive 1, return 1, receive 1 leaves return_received_quantity 2 for 1 fulfilled: RETURN_ITEM (return-item.ts:51-61) checks `fulfilled - return_requested` and forgets what was already received. The search's run is a negative quantity: CANCEL_RETURN_ITEM of -2 passes `!quantity` and `-2 > return_requested` and raises return_requested to 2 with nothing fulfilled. @medusajs/order@2.22.0 does both. The admin route that feeds RETURN_ITEM takes `quantity: z.number()` with no minimum (api/admin/returns/validators.ts:128) and request-item-return.ts:99-104 checks no quantity; whether something else upstream stops either was not found.

Suspected real bug at the module's action level (lower confidence: the claim workflows that emit WRITE_OFF_ITEM were not traced). WRITE_OFF_ITEM (write-off-item.ts:48-53) compares one action's quantity with the item's quantity, not the total written off: two write-offs of 2 on an item of 2 write off 4. The search's run: REINSTATE_ITEM of -3 (any quantity not above the item's passes) raises written_off_quantity to 3 of 2. The original does both.

payment/vendure/orderProcess#a placed or.note: Suspected real bug. Local search: unknown (a state witness, no run within 3 s); a run exists and the original does it: Created, AddingItems, ArrangingPayment, PaymentAuthorized, ArrangingAdditionalPayment, Cancelled with a line still of quantity 1. default-order-process.ts:283-285 `if (toState === 'Cancelled') { return; }` inside the checkAdditionalPaymentsAmount block returns from onTransitionStart itself, so checkAllItemsBeforeCancel (:364-374, documented at :115-121 'Prevents transition to the Cancelled state unless all OrderItems are already cancelled. @default true') never runs from ArrangingAdditionalPayment; from PaymentAuthorized the same cancel is refused. Found by the conformance harness first (as a modelling error in the rule, fixed).

payment/vendure/orderProcess#an order sh.note: Not refuted by the local search (unknown), but a run breaks it and Vendure 2.2.7 does it: Created, AddingItems, ArrangingPayment, PaymentAuthorized, Modifying, Shipped with only an Authorized payment (createFulfillment checks no payment state, and ArrangingAdditionalPayment counts Authorized payments as covering).
